error.limitReached: You have used today's {limit} AI helps. Please try again tomorrow.
error.textTooLong: That text is too long — please keep it under {max} characters.
error.unsupportedWithoutAi: Reading a photo needs the AI assistant, which is not switched on here. Please type the details instead.
error.unavailable: The AI assistant is not answering right now. Please try again in a moment.
error.posterOnly: Only the person who posted this can see its shortlist.
error.imageNotFound: We could not find that image. Please upload it again.
error.imageTooLarge: That image is too large — please use one under 5 MB.
error.imageRequired: Please upload a photo or give a link to one.
error.pdfNeedsUpload: Please upload the PDF file itself rather than a link to it.
error.draftOrOpportunityRequired: Send a draft or the id of a published post.

ask.type: What kind of post is this — a job, freelance work, a local service, a partnership, training or a community activity?
ask.title: What should the heading say?
ask.description: Describe the work in a few lines.
ask.location: Where is the work? An area or locality is enough.
ask.work_mode: Is it on site, remote, or either?
ask.timing: When does it happen, and for how long?
ask.required_capabilities: Which skills or trades does it need?
ask.salary: What is the monthly salary, or a range?
ask.incentive_type: Is there an incentive or commission on top of the fixed pay?
ask.openings: How many people do you need?
ask.shift: Which shift — day, night, rotational or flexible?
ask.interview_details: How and where will you interview?
ask.experience: How many years of experience are needed? Are freshers welcome?
ask.requires_assets: Does the person need their own two-wheeler, licence, phone, laptop or tools?
ask.budget_type: Is the budget a fixed amount or an hourly rate?
ask.hourly_rate: What hourly rate are you offering?
ask.duration: How long will the project take?
ask.experience_level: Do you want an entry-level, intermediate or expert person?
ask.screening_questions: Any questions applicants should answer up front?
ask.preferred_date: Which day do you need it done?
ask.urgency: How urgent is it — today, this week, or flexible?

risk.no_capability_overlap: none of the required skills on their profile
risk.partial_capability_overlap: only some of the required skills
risk.bid_far_below_budget: bid is far below your budget — check the scope

tip.add_title: Add a clear heading that says the role and the place.
tip.shorten_title: Shorten the heading to under 80 characters — people scan.
tip.add_description: Describe the work in a few more lines: duties, place, timings.
tip.add_location: Add the area or locality — nearby people respond most.
tip.set_remote_or_both: Allow remote or either mode to reach people outside your area.
tip.add_capabilities: Pick the skills or trades needed so the right people see it.
tip.fewer_capabilities: Keep to the 3–4 skills that really matter — fewer filters, more responses.
tip.add_salary: Add a salary or range — posts with pay get far more responses.
tip.add_job_timings: Add working hours such as 9 am to 6 pm.
tip.add_openings: Say how many people you need.
tip.lower_min_qualification: Lower the minimum qualification to 12th if the work allows — more responses.
tip.relax_english_level: Ask only for basic English if the work does not need more.
tip.reduce_experience: Ask for less experience, or welcome freshers, to widen the pool.
tip.add_interview_details: Say how and where you will interview.
tip.add_budget: Add a budget — people apply more readily when they know it.
tip.add_hourly_rate: Add the hourly rate you are offering.
tip.add_duration: Say how long the project will take.
tip.add_screening_questions: Add one or two questions so proposals are easier to compare.
tip.add_preferred_date: Add the day you need it done.
tip.set_urgency: Say how urgent it is — today, this week or flexible.
tip.add_timing: Add when it happens and for how long.
tip.add_deadline: Add a last date so people know how soon to respond.
tip.mention_incentives: Mention the incentive or commission in the description too.

improvement.mention_matching_skills: Name the skills of yours that this work needs.
improvement.mention_experience: Say how many years you have done this.
improvement.answer_screening_questions: Answer the questions the person who posted asked.
improvement.keep_it_short: Keep it short — a few lines are read, a page is not.
improvement.remove_contact_details: Leave out phone numbers and e-mail; share them in the chat once connected.
improvement.be_specific_to_this_work: Refer to this particular work, not a general message.
improvement.clear_next_step: End with a clear next step, such as a time to talk.

bid.poster_budget: Based on the budget the person who posted stated: {poster}.
bid.clamped_to_poster_budget: Similar work usually goes for {market}, but this person has offered {poster} — so the suggestion stays within their budget.
bid.market_above_poster_budget: Similar work usually pays {market}, more than this person's budget of {poster}. The suggestion stays at their budget; if the work needs more, say why in your message.
bid.none: No budget was given and there is too little similar work to compare — quote what the work is worth to you.

proposal.interest: I would like to apply for "{title}".
proposal.experience: I have {years} years of experience in this.

availability.later: I can take this up a little later; happy to discuss dates.

proposal.closing: Please let me know a good time to talk.
